subject: Onboarding certificates & offboarding controls — package for SIG review
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluevale.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueVale Security Team <security@bluevale.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: onboarding certificates + offboarding control details for SIG submission

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking this — BlueVale is finishing up our SIG review and we need a concise bundle that demonstrates your employee onboarding and offboarding controls. Specifically we're looking for the following artifacts:

- Proof employees complete security training (latest 12 months) — summary and raw completions if possible
- Redacted background check attestations for the current workforce (company-wide summary + samples)
- The deprovisioning runbook (high-level steps and evidence of execution for recent leavers)
- Example access provisioning logs (redacted) for HR/onboarding events

Do you have a single package or a short link where we can download these? We want to include the artifacts with our SIG submission this week (target: 2028-03-18).

Appreciate a quick turnaround — Emily
Emily Chen
Senior Security Analyst — Vendor Risk
BlueVale Technologies

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T09:55:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: onboarding certificates + offboarding control details for SIG submission

Team — forwarding BlueVale's ask (below). Can you assemble a pack we can send today? Priorities: (1) concise index that maps to SIG/AH (they call out training/bg/prov/deprov), (2) redacted BG attestations (sample of 5, company-wide summary), (3) training completion CSV with date, role, and course id, (4) the deprovisioning runbook and one example execution entry.

Soojin — can you pull the training CSV and provisioning logs?
Lauren — can you produce the redacted BG attestations and the legal-friendly cover note about redaction?
Jordan — please package the runbook and confirm any recent leavers we can show as sample execution (redacted IDs).

I will coordinate the link and send to Emily. If anything is sensitive and needs approvals, flag here.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: onboarding certificates + offboarding control details for SIG submission

Marcus — putting together the extracts now. Quick notes: 

- Training completions: pulled a CSV (attached) with course id, employee id (hashed), completion date, and trainer. I redacted email addresses and employee PII — left role and hire date as requested.
- Provisioning logs: I exported the onboarding events for the last 6 months and redacted account ids; attached a small sample (access-provisioning-log-sample.csv). Full logs are in the secure Drive folder (see link).
- Wanted to confirm whether BlueVale needs notarized BG attestations or just signed vendor attestations; will wait for Lauren on that.

I attached: 20280315-training-completions.csv, access-provisioning-log-sample.csv.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T13:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: onboarding certificates + offboarding control details for SIG submission

Attached are five redacted background check attestations (redacted-bg-attestations-2028-03.pdf).

Notes for the package:
- We removed names, dates of birth and SSNs, replaced employee IDs with hashed values. Each attestation retains the vendor stamp and the date the check completed.
- Company-wide summary: 98.7% of active staff have completed prehire background checks; 1.3% are pending due to recent hires (list included in the summary).
- Legal cover note included at the front of the PDF describing the redaction approach and contact for further verification under NDA.

I also reviewed the runbook — Jordan has the latest v2. I left minor comments on step 4 (revocation for shared keys) that Jordan can address before finalizing.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of People Ops (Security Programs)
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluevale.com>
Cc: BlueVale Security Team <security@bluevale.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-16T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding certificates + offboarding control details for SIG submission — package link

Hi Emily — thanks for the patience. Attaching a short bundle and a link to the secure folder for full artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bredwood/bluevale-sig-package

What we included: 
- 20280315-training-completions.csv (course id, role, hashed employee id, completion date)
- redacted-bg-attestations-2028-03.pdf (5 sample attestations + legal cover note)
- deprovisioning-runbook-2027-v2.md (internal runbook, redaction notes included)
- access-provisioning-log-sample.csv (redacted sample rows)

Short answers to your bullets: 
- Training: all active employees complete required role-based training on hire and annually; completion tracking is in our LMS and we attached the export.
- BG attestations: vendor-verified; we provided redacted samples and a company-wide completion summary in the PDF.
- Deprovisioning: runbook covers system-level revocation, identity provider removal, cloud IAM role cleanup and ticketing confirmation; Jordan has added recent execution examples (redacted) to the runbook.

If BlueVale needs additional material (e.g., full log exports under NDA or notarized attestations), let us know and we will route it through legal. Otherwise we hope this covers the SIG submission checklist — target completion for your intake was 2028-03-18, so please confirm receipt and whether anything else is needed.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20280315-training-completions.csv, redacted-bg-attestations-2028-03.pdf, deprovisioning-runbook-2027-v2.md, access-provisioning-log-sample.csv
